title: Spring Super Fan promotion (Fiebre de la Super Fan de primavera)
names_seen: Spring Super Fan promotion (Fiebre de la Super Fan de primavera)

facts.statement: Between April 22 and April 25, purchases of Station Cash earned double Station Cash; Free Realms was listed among the participating games in the spring event.
facts.quote: Entre el 22 y el 25 de abril, ¡obten doble Station Cash con la compra de tu SC!

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New? (Fiebre de la Super Fan de primavera)
article_summaries.summary: A Spanish-language SOE news post announcing a spring promotion in which purchases of Station Cash earned double SC from April 22 to 25. Free Realms is one of several SOE titles participating, alongside EverQuest, EverQuest II, EverQuest II Extended, Star Wars Galaxies and Clone Wars Adventures. The post gives no year and does not describe any Free Realms-specific reward; SMS Station Cash purchases were excluded.
